basic_profile.bio: A passionate audiophile and vintage sound equipment collector based in Christchurch, New Zealand. I spend my days as an electrical engineer, specializing in audio tech, and my evenings are dedicated to refining my sound system and connecting with fellow enthusiasts online. I'm a single guy in my late 30s, and when I'm not working or on Reddit, you might find me tinkering in my home workshop or attending local car meets. I'm an avid fan of the NY Giants and love sharing tips and advice on sound equipment and sports memorabilia. Typically online in the evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in electrical engineering and over 15 years of experience in the audio tech field, I have an extensive knowledge of sound systems. My expertise comes from both formal education and years of self-teaching through hands-on projects and active participation in audiophile communities.
